diagnosis: OtpVerificationRateThrottle builds its throttle key from request.data.get('phone_number'), but VerifyPhoneOtpView validates code directly against request.user's state. An attacker can brute-force the 4-digit or 6-digit OTP on an account by cycling random dummy phone_number values in each request, evading the 5/minute throttle limit entirely.
exploit_request:
POST /api/auth/verify-otp/ HTTP/1.1
Host: security.service.net
Authorization: Bearer <session_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"code": "0421", "phone_number": "555-0001"}
